NewsArticle.Title: Nightmare of the Cthonic Disciple
NewsArticle.Content:
Gregory, the attendent of the Temple of the Veil, begrudgingly reveals his secret of the Cthonic Disciple.
Male Wizards and Priests with eighty insights: Discover the nightmare of the ancient, cthonic evil.
Dream of the Cthonic Disciple of the ancient evil and become a Cthonic Disciple.
